rule: For EVERY change to the working .ipynb, including minor edits/comments: take and readback a numbered PRE archive of its exact bytes, then update original working path, increment YYYYMMDD-NNN for source revision creation date in Nepal, and verify POST. Never overwrite numbered archives.
numbering_date_basis: Git commit/provider creation date converted to Asia/Kathmandu
number_sequence: reset counter to 001 on each new Nepal calendar date; increment by one for every new source mutation
